companyName: Capital Power U.S. Natural Gas JV
rationale: Archive the Capital Power U.S. Natural Gas JV record and retire its purported Apollo ownership because the record was created from a non-binding, pre-definitive MOU rather than an owned portfolio company. The December 2025 announcement and presentation describe only a planned partnership to pursue future acquisitions, the presentation expressly labels the Apollo MOU non-binding, March 2026 disclosure says documentation and acquisitions remained incomplete, and Capital Power's July 2026 quarterly report identifies no closing, funded legal vehicle, Apollo-backed acquisition, or related equity-accounted asset. No Apollo closing announcement was found. The approved archive overlay removes the evaluated seed entry, while the database retains an archived audit record and its relations rather than deleting history.

beforeImage.name: Capital Power U.S. Natural Gas JV
beforeImage.subsector: Merchant natural gas generation investment platform
beforeImage.description: The Capital Power U.S. Natural Gas JV is an investment partnership formed to acquire and operate U.S. natural gas-fired generation assets. Its target customer base is the wholesale power market, and the platform is intended to follow an asset-heavy merchant generation ownership model. Capital Power disclosed in late 2025 that Apollo-managed funds and Capital Power had signed an MOU to pursue acquisitions together with up to $3 billion of committed equity. Public disclosures indicate Apollo may provide up to $2.25 billion of that commitment and Capital Power up to $750 million, with Capital Power acting as operator for acquired assets. Reviewed public sources do not disclose a finalized ownership split because the platform was announced as a new investment partnership rather than as a completed portfolio acquisition.

milestones.event: Capital Power and Apollo-managed funds signed an MOU to form a U.S. natural gas generation investment partnership.
The parties disclosed up to $3 billion of equity commitments for future acquisitions.
Capital Power was identified as operator for assets to be acquired by the partnership.

afterImage.description: Archived census record for a prospective U.S. natural-gas acquisition partnership between Capital Power and Apollo-managed funds. In December 2025 the parties announced a non-binding memorandum of understanding contemplating up to US$3 billion of potential equity for future merchant-generation acquisitions. Capital Power's March 2026 disclosures said definitive documentation and acquisitions remained incomplete, and its July 2026 quarterly report identified no partnership closing, funded legal vehicle, jointly acquired asset, or Apollo-backed equity-accounted investment. No current or pending definitive Apollo ownership was established, so this record is excluded from the portfolio-company census.
